metadata.title: Three formulas for the Ising and Potts invariants of a knot or link
metadata.abstract: Jones described how the Ising and Potts models from statistical mechanics give rise, with appropriate choices of Boltzmann weights, to invariants of an oriented link. The Boltzmann weights that Jones proposed, however, work only with a correction factor that he does not mention. We fill in the missing details in two different ways. We also show that all of these invariants, which we call the Ising and Potts invariants, are given by evaluating the Jones polynomial at $t$ equal to one of these Boltzmann weights.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 补全由 Ising/Potts 权重定义结不变量所需修正因子，并证明它们是 Jones 多项式特定取值。
analysis.breakthrough: 厘清旧公式缺项和多种表达的一致性。
analysis.limitations: 不产生一般新的完备结不变量。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
analysis.priorityReason: 以专门公式修补与统一为主，对本组核心方向影响有限，后读。
